This is Croissant. And yes, he loves butter.


I was born in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada, where I completed my Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry at the University of Manitoba. 
I spent the last 10 years working at the National Microbiology Laboratory studying ebola. 
I am hoping that this program will help me advance my career into the world of biotechnology.
